Our Vision

We see every conversation holds the power to make a real difference.

Some conversations change what we know. Others change how we see ourselves, our circumstances and what may be possible.

We believe those moments matter, because they can influence the choices we make and the way we move forward.

Mission

Our Mission

Empower You To Be an Effective Change Agent By delivering high-quality coaching education and coaching service

  • Our coaching program empowers you with the skills and knowledge to drive impactful change.
  • Grounded in scientific research and best practices, our approach facilitates profound learning.
  • It enables significant transformations that resonate well beyond individual sessions, ensuring lasting results in your personal and professional life.

Our Approach

Changing how change happens.

For more than a decade, our founder, Dr Ben Koh, has pursued research and fieldwork into how people think, learn and change. That body of work led to CMA’s proprietary transformational approach to coaching — grounded in science, refined through practice, and now taught and applied across the globe.

It goes beyond solving the immediate problem by working with how people make sense of what they are facing — helping them think differently, choose with greater ownership and strengthen their capacity to adapt as circumstances change.

This is the foundation of our Transformative Edge™ — shaping how we educate coach practitioners, build coaching capability in organisations and work directly with people through coaching.

CMA

Conversation. Meaning. Agency.

We are a global coaching organisation with more than a decade of work across professional coaching certification, organisational coaching capability and coaching services.

At the heart of our work, one question has continued to guide us:

How can coaching help people create change they can truly own?

That question has shaped how we educate, how we work with organisations and how we coach.

It has also kept us looking beyond technique and immediate solutions towards a deeper understanding of how change happens.

What We Do

Professional Coaching Certification

We train people to become skilful practitioner through a complete ICF-accredited education pathway, from foundational certification through advanced mastery and team coaching.

Our coaching education combines internationally recognised professional standards with CMA’s proprietary methodology, and has earned industry recognition and university endorsement.

Explore Coaching Certification

Organisational Coaching Capability

We help organisations build coaching capability in their leaders and managers, so they can develop people through the realities of everyday work — not only through formal development programmes.

Our workplace solutions help leaders create stronger conversations around performance, learning, ownership and growth.

Build Coaching Capability

Coaching Services

We work directly with individuals and leaders navigating important decisions, transitions and complexity.

Our coaching creates the space to think clearly, understand what matters and move forward with choices they can stand behind.

Engage Coaching Services
